heroTitle: Understand your cycle. Feel better in your body.
heroText: I'm Elsa, an osteopath. I help women understand their cycle, from coming off the pill to menopause.

concerns.title: What brings you here?
concerns.unsure: Not sure which box is yours, or ticking several at once? That's very common. Tell me what's going on in a first call and we'll untangle it together.
concerns.note: I don't diagnose or prescribe treatment: my work sits alongside your medical care.

meetElsa.title: Why I do this work
meetElsa.text:
For years I lived with acne, PMS, gut issues and painful periods. I spent seven years on the pill without knowing what my own cycle felt like. When I came off it, everything came back, and I had little real guidance.

I did end up understanding my body, but it took years. I started The Cycle Space so you don't have to work it out alone.

homeTool.title: Track your cycle.
homeTool.description: Estimate your next period, ovulation and fertile window. Everything stays in your browser.
homeTool.note: Estimates only: not medical advice and not a method of contraception.
